properties.description: Every presented data byte is justified by an earlier accepted input prefix or by zero padding after input completion; byte order and truncation are checked regardless of ready.
Every presented data beat has the required last indication at the clamped frame boundary, including streaming partial prefixes.
Presented headers correspond in order to completed accepted frames, with exact original length, adjusted length, padding and truncation flags; header consumption is independent of data consumption.
Blocked data and header responses retain valid and all enabled payload fields through the next observation, unless reset cancels them.

Synchronous reset clears response valids and cancels scoreboard obligations without erasing earlier alarms. Meaningful unknown controls or accepted payloads, oversized frames and scoreboard exhaustion cannot establish success.

Combinational final-marker completion check requires no incomplete input or outstanding data/header obligation, no remaining presented valid or source offer, and at least 32 uninterrupted drain-tail edges. It does not infer unbounded liveness or certify the externally required 128-edge final-tail qualification.
